# /playsound and /stopsound: every sound source with every optional argument, success and error cases (feedback only).
# Flat world, creative; Bot = op at 0.5 -60 0.5, Bot0 = level 0.

gamerule spawn_mobs false

# ---- master ----
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master @a
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master @a 0 -60 0
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master @a ~ ~ ~
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 0.5
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 1000
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 0 1
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 1 0.5 0.2
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 1 2 1
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 1 0 0
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master nobody
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master @e[type=minecraft:cow]
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 -1
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 x
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 1 3
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 1 1 2
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 1 1 -1
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot ~ ~
@bot playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master
playsound minecraft:nope master Bot
@bot0 playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot
stopsound Bot master
stopsound @a master
stopsound Bot master minecraft:entity.pig.ambient
stopsound Bot master minecraft:nope
stopsound nobody master
stopsound Bot master minecraft:entity.pig.ambient extra

# ---- stopsound ----
stopsound
stopsound Bot
stopsound @a
stopsound nobody
stopsound Bot *
stopsound Bot * minecraft:entity.pig.ambient
stopsound Bot * minecraft:nope
stopsound Bot nope
stopsound Bot * minecraft:entity.pig.ambient extra
@bot0 stopsound Bot
@bot0 stopsound Bot *
stopsound @e[type=minecraft:cow] *
playsound
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient nope
playsound minecraft:entity.pig.ambient master Bot 0 -60 0 1 1 0 extra
playsound 123 master Bot
playsound #minecraft:nope master Bot
